rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Origin SEC Registry provides structured access to SEC EDGAR filings for over 8,000 US public companies, delivering company profiles, earnings transcripts, and market quotes in approximately 200 tokens per response. Every response includes a cryptographic origin leaf linking back to SEC-signed source data, creating a verifiable chain of provenance. The registry supports a free no-key tier at 100 requests per hour and integrates natively as an MCP server for AI assistants.
